title: Introduction to AI
lead: Covers: what AI is, its three levels (ANI, AGI, ASI), a short history (WWII, Turing, Dartmouth), the Turing Test and the Chinese Room, rule-based (GOFAI) versus data-driven AI, big data, the AI map, predictive versus generative AI, and how an AI system senses and acts. No prior lecture attendance needed.
